reviews.title: Be Careful with the Automatic Subscription
reviews.text:
I signed up for the free trial, but it automatically converted into a $165.44 annual subscription without me realizing it.

While I understand that free trials can automatically renew, I think the transition to a paid annual plan should be much more transparent, with a clearer warning before such a significant charge.

I ended up being charged for an entire year of a service I never intended to subscribe to.

Be very careful when signing up for the free trial, and make sure to cancel before it ends to avoid an unexpected charge.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I’m disappointed with the lack of flexibility in BoldVoice. While the app uses AI to personalize your learning journey, you cannot freely browse and select specific lessons from the curriculum. Instead, you have to wait for the system to decide what comes next.

BoldVoice suggested using features like the Sound Library, Just Speak, AI Chat, and practicing your own text, but these don’t solve the core issue. If I know I need to work on a specific pronunciation skill or lesson, I should be able to select it directly.

Personalization is useful, but it shouldn’t come at the expense of user choice. For a paid learning app, I expected much more control over how and what I practice. Hopefully BoldVoice adds this flexibility in the future.

reviews.title: Frustrating subscription and cancellation experience
reviews.text: I am very disappointed with how the trial and cancellation process is handled on this app. I signed up for a 1-week free trial, but trying to cancel before getting charged turned into a frustrating runaround between the app interface and the Stripe billing portal. Be very careful starting a trial if you don't intend to keep a costly subscription.

reviews.title: Bug
reviews.text:
I like this app but set 1 star to attract more attention from developers. I already wrote them that there was a bug and they responded with some excuse that says they will not change anything. The bug is: When I am using airpods, I can hear all sounds in aipods, but when I talk, my recorded sound is recorded from phone’s microphone and not airpod’s microphone! So in loud environment the recording is extremely weak if the phone is in your hand or hanging on some support, but when I talk straight to phone’s microphone even when airpods are connected, then sounds is recorded clearly. I also tried to use cable headphones with USB-C adapter. In that case the sound is recorded correctly from headphone’s microphone. So SAME headphones´ mic not working with bluetooth and work with cable.
The thing is that I bought subscription and in my case when I have some time and want to exercise I always hit the wall of this bug I just CANNOT use this app. I cannot carry cable headphones and adapter every time. This is a great app but this stupid bug is very frustrating.
For those users who want to use their AirPods just know, this app is NOT WORKING with them correctly.

reviews.title: A lot of errors
reviews.text: I've been using this app for two weeks. Although it’s helpful for accent training, it’s full of errors. After each lesson, it shows an error message and suggests contacting the developer. My iPhone app stopped working within two weeks. When I used it on my iPad, it started a new lesson without syncing with my iPhone progress. Also, when I tried deleting and reinstalling the app, it warned that reinstalling would cause data loss. Despite being expensive, the app’s poor quality is clear through the frequent errors it causes. For this error-prone app, it should not be given a high rating.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
Everyone — do not install this app! These are scammers! Under the guise of technical issues, they steal money.

When installing the app, it stated that the first week was a free trial and that we would be notified before the trial period ended and before any money was charged. However, after five days, I received a notification from my credit card that this app had attempted to charge my card, but I never received any email warning that the trial period was ending. Moreover, the charge they attempted was for a full annual subscription. Fortunately, my credit card declined the transaction.

I then went to the “Subscriptions” section in my phone’s settings, but this app was not listed there. After that, I logged into my account within the app’s settings and tried to cancel the subscription. I pressed the delete/cancel option multiple times, but the subscription would not be removed. I also tried to switch from the annual plan to a monthly plan, but that didn’t work either.

I decided not to do anything further at that moment, but the next morning they tried to charge my card again. I then went into the app and DELETED MY ACCOUNT. Two days later, they tried to charge my card again.

In the end, I had to block my card and request a replacement.

reviews.title: Potential Scam and Fraudulent Billing Practices
reviews.text:
Warning: Potential Scam and Fraudulent Billing Practices

I would give zero rating since no option to give zero, giving one. 
I signed up for a 7-day trial and attempted to unsubscribe well within the trial period. The system repeatedly blocked cancellation and instead pushed a 50% “offer,” after which I was charged $99 without authorization. Shortly after, I was also charged $149 plus an additional $99, totaling charges for two accounts I never approved.

When I contacted customer service, I was told nothing could be done, despite clear evidence that the charges occurred during my attempt to cancel. My emails received automated responses with no resolution.

These practices appear deceitful, misleading, and potentially fraudulent. Consumers deserve transparency, fair billing, and the ability to cancel trials without being charged multiple unauthorized fees.

I urge Apple, Google Play, and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to review and investigate BoldVoice’s billing practices.
Please be cautious  in my experience, this service did not honor its trial, cancellation, or customer service commitments.
